summary: Rabbi Harari discusses the importance of Erev Shabbat preparation by contrasting the practical and spiritual approaches found in the Gemara and the Ramchal. He explores the idea that creating a distinction between Friday and Shabbat through clothing and meals enhances the experience of the holy day. The class concludes with a reflection from Rabbi Soloveitchik on the necessity of cultivating an Erev Shabbat mindset to truly appreciate the sanctity of Shabbat.
questions: Why did the rabbis wear simple clothing on Friday?
Is the prohibition against a large meal on Erev Shabbat only about having an appetite?
What did Rabbi Soloveitchik mean by the loss of Erev Shabbat Jews?
How can we create a contrast between Friday and Shabbat?
